result.summary: Found 2 issues: one clear content/data error and one layout problem where the bottom navigation overlaps content.

issues.description: The restaurant card for "Smash Bros Burgers" shows "€NaN delivery," which is clearly invalid and looks like a failed price calculation.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee data binding/calculation and ensure a valid numeric price is rendered, or fall back to a safe placeholder if the value is unavailable.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlays the restaurant list, cutting off the next card at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so the fixed navigation bar does not obscure list items.
